body: EARLY MOVING-TREE FINDING (not final review): both from methods currently use raw.trim.nonEmpty, but the contract says whitespace-only. On this JVM, U+2003 EM SPACE gives trim().isEmpty == false while Character.isWhitespace(U+2003) == true, so PromptTemplateVersion.from("\u2003") and FindingNote.from("\u2003") are presently admitted. Please use the repository's portable Char.isWhitespace precedent (or explicitly define the narrower ASCII rule) and add U+2003 to both rejection courts before freezing. Preserve admitted nonblank bytes unchanged. I have not reviewed the rest of the moving diff.
